body: Create lib/handoff.mjs exporting runTicketHandoff and formatHandoffMarkdown to execute runGateTicket, run single-diff cross-model prosecute() when agy + quota are available (or emit prosecutorPrompt in prompt-only/zero-agy fallback mode unless requireProsecutor: true), and render a P5/P6 Markdown + optional --html handoff dossier. Export extractInlinePlanComments and compilePlanDelta in lib/plan.mjs and wire deltaFrom into compilePlan and buildPlanPrompts so untouched tickets in a prior plan.json are preserved verbatim while modified, commented, or newly added tickets are incrementally recompiled. Add test/handoff-and-plan-delta.test.mjs. Verify: node --test test/handoff-and-plan-delta.test.mjs test/plan.test.mjs
title: Interactive /agb-handoff Single-Ticket Gate & Incremental agb plan --delta Compiler
